summary: A full page layout starts with semantic tags for each region. The CSS then names a grid area for each one and draws the layout as a map.
notes: The wrapper div is the grid container. header, nav, main, aside, and footer are its grid items.
Keep the HTML in a sensible reading order. Screen readers and the Tab key follow the HTML, not the grid.
The h1 is inside main, because the club name in the header is repeated on every page.
pitfall: Rearranging the HTML so it matches the visual layout. Leave the HTML in reading order and let grid-template-areas move things.
